results.title: Shroomery
results.overview: Tired and overworked, Lacey comes home to discover her boyfriend Miles has not only neglected to clean the apartment, he's left a disturbing surprise in the refrigerator: rapidly growing "shrooms" that he acquired from a sketchy janitor. The couple's initial curiosity leads to terror as the mushrooms take over their kitchen, minds, and ultimately bodies.

results.title: Dancing with the Bear
results.overview: Linda and Marek are faced with the decision of whether to keep the unborn child, who has a high probability of being born with Down syndrome and a vision of a "poor" life, or to abort it through medical intervention.

results.title: Ozhiyathe
results.overview: In August 1976, 19 schoolboys from Koduvayoor were arrested without cause and tormented for 21 days under the Emergency. Ozhiyathe brings this unrecorded true story of injustice and resilience finally to light.

results.title: From Hope to Home: The Obama Presidential Center
results.original_title: From Hope to Home: The Obama Presidential Center
results.overview: The Obama Presidential Center's star-studded grand opening ceremony brings a slew of celebrities and dignitaries to Chicago for the big event.  The festivities feature what organizers said would be "legendary performances by global icons and powerful remarks from today's most prominent voices."  Bruce Springsteen, Stevie Wonder, Christina Aguilera, John Legend and Bono are just some of the many big names slated to perform.

results.title: Joker Out - 10 Years Karneval
results.overview: Joker Out is undoubtedly one of Slovenia's most successful and popular music groups. To mark their tenth anniversary, they staged a musical spectacular titled *Karneval* at the Kardeljevi ploščadi in Ljubljana. The event featured an evening of superb music, impressive visual production, acrobatic and circus performances, and guest artists. The concert was the highlight of a day-long festival celebration marking the band's decade-long successful musical journey.

results.title: Sinister Secret Ingredient
results.overview: When dentist Mel buys a small-town clinic to start a new life, she meets Ruth, a beloved baker and neighbor with a tragic past. But when Mel’s 12-year-old daughter Abby goes missing, Mel uncovers Ruth’s horrifying secret.

results.title: Mann-Pishach
results.overview: In June 1990, a junior archaeologist travels to the isolated village of Hadamgaon to investigate a mysterious stone dome revealed after a monsoon landslide. As he stays with a young widow and observes the village’s strange customs, sealed homes, deserted streets, and a strict rule to lock indoors before nightfall, he uncovers a buried structure built not to worship but to contain the darkest impulses of the human mind. In Hadamgaon, what is buried does not remain silent for long.

results.title: Folkloric
results.overview: Pequi is an awkward saci who believes he's unlucky for having been born with his left foot. To fix this, he sets off on a fun adventure through the Folclórica forest with his friend Teobaldo and the brave curupira Ingá. Along the way, they face challenges and encounter magical creatures from Brazilian folklore.

results.title: Retrospection
results.overview: Timothee and Hope reunite after years apart under mysterious circumstances. As the key to the future, they must race against time to prevent a radical organization, led by Agent 5010 and his counterparts, from exploiting their special abilities.

results.title: Ronita Rambo
results.overview: Ronita Rambo, the sharp-tongued waitress of a rural Missouri diner, has everyone's order memorized - but not a clue how to text her new crush. Enlisting the help of two gay teens, she takes an unexpected leap toward love and authenticity.

results.title: Lali
results.overview: Bound by love and haunted by fate, Zeba and Sajawal spiral through feelings of desire, superstition and fear in Lali, a darkly comic tale where the living share a restless world with the ghosts.

results.title: Blue Has No Borders
results.overview: A young filmmaker is determined to know her neighbours in the port town of Folkestone. But in the aftermath of Brexit, building new relationships isn’t easy.

results.title: The Ballad of Akabusi
results.overview: He goes by many names: The Landlord, The Big Cheese, The Swiss Cheese, Brie Larsson, Henrik Larsson, Lars Ricken, but most people know him as Busi - and he runs this city.

results.title: Haunted
results.overview: Mathilde, a troubled teenage girl who moves to the countryside with her family, finds out her new home is haunted by Isabeau, an amnesiac 19th-century ghost. The two form an unexpected friendship and team up to uncover Isabeau's past.

results.title: Wild
results.overview: The story of WILD transports viewers to a world where myth intertwines with history – the mysterious, majestic 17th-century Carpathians. At the center of the story is a half-wild, mute warrior – raised by both animals and mountain people. His fate intertwines with the brutal mission of an imperial inquisitor who, under the pretext of recovering stolen papal insignia, unleashes a bloody revenge. Against the backdrop of monumental mountains, a duel between two worlds unfolds – nature and civilization, freedom and fanaticism, instinct and power.

results.title: Red Thunder VS The Intrusive Thoughts
results.original_title: Red Thunder VS The Intrusive Thoughts
results.overview: A supervillain's plot to take over the world using a helmet that can read minds runs awry after an encounter with a man with some anxious thoughts and a secret identity.

results.title: WAG
results.overview: Entering the world of WAGs (wives and girlfriends) for the first time, Madison finds herself in a space where image is everything and little goes unspoken. Over the course of a single day, she follows her boyfriend through the rhythms of his soccer life, observing from the edges as she tries to find her place. But as the line between support and self-erasure begins to blur, Madison is forced to confront what it means to belong in a world built on appearances.

results.title: Kentucky Bourbon
results.overview: Hoping to leave behind his battle with alcoholism, Ivory relocates with his wife, Zoë, to an idyllic suburban community. Their fresh start quickly devolves into an uncanny nightmare as their overly hospitable neighbors reveal an insatiable hunger, forcing Ivory to battle both the bottle calling his name and the terror closing in outside his door.
